Warning: This may come across as insensitive, but honestly it's the way I work and other people may benefit from it. A lot of people don't realize to think about things this way or think that I'm a bitch for saying this. It just happens to be how my story played out and it is in no way meant to upset anybody. Anyway, here we go.

Almost 2 years ago my ex-boyfriend passed in a car accident, and I spiraled into a deep, deep depression. Things were really bad for a while. I started cutting myself again, popping pills, and drinking A LOT. I tried so many things to cope but nothing worked. I had thought about/planned suicide since the accident and one night I just decided I couldn't handle life anymore and I ODed. Once I had drank all that charcoal crap and talked to some of the counselors in the ER, they sent me to a mental hospital strapped down in the back of the ambulance. I was there for a couple weeks before they let me check out. Maybe a couple weeks after that I was no longer suicidal, I was still extremely depressed and cutting myself though. Even though I was slowly coming to terms with things and coping in healthier ways, I would still have a really bad day every so often and cut myself and/or drank a lot. Most of the time both. As time kept passing I had fewer and fewer bad days. One day everything came rushing back very suddenly and unexpectedly. For some reason on this day though I had just decided I was tired of being so upset all the time. So I quite literally just stopped giving a fuck about anything. That's all I did; I quit caring. I was not sad. I was not mad. I was not happy. Nothing. Since I could now block any emotional connection to anything things got back to normal much faster. It's pretty hard to explain. See, I really do enjoy life and everything that's out there in the world, so blocking out any emotions in my head meant that I was able to get involved in activities again. I made myself do activities that I knew I loved before all this happened. Eventually that got me to a point where I could once again handle my emotions without freaking the fuck out. I still get upset sometimes, but I've finally gotten past how depressed I was. The only thing that seemed to help for me was seriously just not giving a fuck.
